errors.text_span: Dieses Balkendiagramm zeigt die Entwicklung der Importe von Aluminium, Kupfer und Nickel aus Russland in den Jahren 2021, 2022 und 2023.
errors.evidence: The description treats the figure as a single bar chart, but it actually contains two separate charts, one for "Deutschland" (Germany) and one for the "EU".
The description states the color for the year 2022 is "hellblau" (light blue), but the bars and legend clearly show it is purple.

errors.text_span: Die Importwerte für Aluminium betragen 2021 3,6 %, 2022 4,4 % und 2023 5,1 %.
errors.evidence: The reported values for Aluminium are incorrect. For Germany, the values are 3.6%, 2.7%, and 1.0%. For the EU, they are 3.2%, 2.8%, and 1.7%. The description incorrectly lists 4.4% and 5.1% for 2022 and 2023, which are values associated with Copper in the EU chart.

errors.text_span: Die Importwerte für Kupfer belägen 2021 1,0 %, 2022 1,7 % und 2023 1,3 %.
errors.evidence: The reported values for Copper are incorrect. For Germany, the values are 8.3%, 11.3%, and 2.2%. For the EU, they are 4.4%, 5.1%, and 1.3%. The description incorrectly lists 1.0% and 1.7%, which are values from the Aluminium category.

errors.text_span: Die Importwerte für Nickel beliefen sich auf 2,2 % im Jahr 2021, 2,8 % im Jahr 2022 und 1,4 % im Jahr 2023.
errors.evidence: The reported values for Nickel are incorrect. For Germany, the values are 25.1%, 24.7%, and 11.4%. For the EU, they are 24.3%, 23.3%, and 14.6%. The values reported in the description (2.2%, 2.8%, 1.4%) are completely wrong and appear to be mixed from other categories or are hallucinated.

errors.text_span: Die Balken zeigen eine allgemeine Variation der Importvolumina für jeden Rohstoff im Zeitverlauf, wobei die höchsten Werte im Allgemeinen im Jahr 2022 und die niedrigsten im Jahr 2023 zu sehen sind.
errors.evidence: This sentence provides an interpretation and summary of trends, which the prompt explicitly forbids ('Vermeiden Sie es, Schlussfolgerungen zu ziehen...'). The description should only state the visual facts and values.
